meta.title: Adapter Compat
meta.description: Eight-in-one DSH LLM adapter shim (backfills LlmAdapter base methods / auto-compaction hard gate / settings null-Config crash guard / CJK context-pressure calibration / session-disk watch + title projection warm-up / compaction .txt export setting / version pager toggle / version family protection + disk cleanup): fixes silent /compact failure from missing imageRequestPricing; disables auto-compaction at the code layer (manual /compact unaffected); normalizes the cordis-frozen null runtime.Config to undefined, fixing the model page not opening, settings save failures, and broken Agent preset switching (host describe/write crashes take everything down); calibrates contextPressure heuristic extrapolation with measured ratios, fixing Chinese sessions that report "over 1M limit" while showing 10% left; watches the sessions directory so the list is rescanned and title projections rebuilt automatically after dsh-sync downloads land, no restart needed; **compaction summary follows the currently selected model** (fixes "switched the model in the UI but /compact still uses the old one before any message is sent" — the summary request's latest comes from request/header, which is only written when a request is actually dispatched; this layer pins the summary target to the modelSelection projection's pending ?? lastUsed); **compaction .txt export setting** (choose never/auto/always + threshold on the settings page; the value still writes webin's config.json, which webin re-reads per request so changes apply immediately, and ticking the pager toggle alone never touches webin config); **version pager toggle** (the "version switch" button that appears on forked/edited conversations, hidden by default — CSS-only hiding of data-dsh-easyrewrite=version-pager, never touches dsh-easyrewrite files); **version family protection + disk cleanup** (a fork copies parent history with parentSession recorded in the header; measured 17 copies at 21.97MB; true delete skips family members by default so switching versions never physically amputates the other branch; the settings page lists family sizes and allows per-family cleanup of old versions). **Sidebar four-group folding** (9999.9.43: fold triangles for top settings / files / cost / bottom settings, overlay + CSS cascade that never touches the host React tree; sidebar content injected by other plugins is auto-grouped by position, state persists to disk; the settings card offers expand-all and full hiding of the three entries). Independent of any protected plugin — never modifies its files and survives reinstalling an older version via pnpm install; also independent of config files, surviving cordis.patch.yml overwrites.
